description: Scoring weights used by Aurora and any automated sync scripts to compute priority_score for queue items.

rules.reason: Blocking tasks gate all dependent work — highest urgency.
Security posture and pentest readiness directly affect engagement timelines.
Unresolved architecture issues create persistent terminology and design drift across agents and contributors.
Live docs mismatch and stale scope create compound risk when picked up by agents without context.
Decision gates must be elevated so they are not missed by agents scanning the queue.
Items that block downstream work should be resolved ahead of the blocked items.
Blocked items cannot be started — deprioritize in the ranked view.

CRITICAL.note: Must resolve before downstream work. Surface immediately to Aurora and operator.

HIGH.note: Resolve within current sprint or session. Do not leave unassigned.

MEDIUM.note: Resolve this cycle. Safe for agents with appropriate context packs.

LOW.note: Queue for next sprint. Review if it ages past 30 days without progress.

escalation_triggers: Any item in state 'blocked' for > 7 days: escalate to Aurora.
Any item with decision_required == true and no activity for > 3 days: hail operator via PAT.
Any new issue with labels 'security' or 'blocking': auto-add to queue with score >= 30.
